world.title: Zohran Mamdani Slams ICE Agents After Man Shot In New York City
world.summary: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents shot and wounded a man in a car in the Bronx, New York City, on Thursday, with a child present. Eyewitness accounts and city officials confirmed the incident. New York Assembly member Zohran Mamdani condemned the shooting, calling it "unconscionable," and stated he contacted President Donald Trump regarding the situation.

world.title: Iran sanctions: US names five Indian nationals, two companies in latest crackdown
world.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on five Indian nationals and two Mumbai-based companies as part of its ongoing efforts to combat Iran's oil trade and sanctions-evasion networks. This action, announced by the US Treasury Department, aims to disrupt entities that assist Tehran in maintaining its oil exports amid existing sanctions. The crackdown reflects Washington's intensified focus on Iran-related activities.

world.title: Trump says U.S. will not resume military strikes on Iran before Nov. 3 midterm elections
world.summary: President Donald Trump announced on October 8, 2026, that the U.S. will not resume military strikes on Iran prior to the November 3 midterm elections. This statement comes amid renewed discussions and heightened regional tensions. Trump made the announcement while campaigning for Republican candidates, indicating a focus on domestic political considerations in the lead-up to the elections.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Going Into Trade On Oct 9
business.summary: On October 9, the Gift Nifty was trading at approximately 22,356, indicating a premium of 62.80 points over the previous Nifty futures close, suggesting a negative opening for the Nifty 50. The NSE Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex experienced declines of 1.64% and 1.44%, respectively, reflecting ongoing market volatility and investor sentiment ahead of trading.

business.title: Stocks in news: TCS, ITC, Infosys, Cochin Shipyard and RIL
business.summary: On Thursday, financial markets fell nearly 1.5%, with the Nifty index nearing its April 2026 low. TCS reported a 15% increase in consolidated net profit for the second quarter. ITC participated in a significant block trade, while shares of Infosys and Wipro declined during US market hours, highlighting ongoing vulnerabilities in the market.

business.title: Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech, other IT shares in focus owing to multiple factors today; Details here
business.summary: US-listed shares of Indian IT companies Infosys and Wipro experienced declines of up to 4% due to H-1B visa developments but later recovered. Wipro's ADR ended unchanged, while Infosys's ADR gained 1.1%. Other companies like TCS, HCLTech, and Persistent Systems are also under scrutiny due to various global and local factors affecting their stock performance.

technology.title: iPhone 17 price drops to Rs 79,999 with Rs 5,000 instant discount and Rs 9,001 flat discount
technology.summary: The iPhone 17 256GB is now priced at Rs 79,999 during the Flipkart Big Billion Days sale. This includes a Rs 5,000 instant discount and an additional Rs 9,001 flat discount. Originally listed at Rs 84,999, the phone also qualifies for an extra Rs 5,000 discount for ICICI Bank customers, making it a notable offer for buyers.

technology.title: Autonomous vehicles can still see lanes through tampered sensors-but in the wrong place
technology.summary: Researchers at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) have found that autonomous vehicles can still detect lane markings even when sensors are tampered with, although the information may be inaccurate. This highlights the critical role of computer systems in processing sensor data for driver-assistance systems, which are now standard in most modern vehicles, impacting overall safety.

technology.title: Arc Raiders Frozen Trail update: Pendola Pass map, new weapons, and more
technology.summary: Embark Studios released the Frozen Trail 2.0 update for ARC Raiders on October 8, 2026. This update is described as the largest since the game's launch, introducing a new Pendola Pass map and additional weapons. Players can expect enhanced gameplay features and improvements, further expanding the game's content and experience. The update aims to engage the player community effectively.

sports.title: Abhishek Sharma on the cusp of T20I history, 53 runs away from breaking Suryakumar Yadav’s unique record
sports.summary: Abhishek Sharma is on the verge of achieving a milestone in his T20I career, needing just 53 runs to reach 2,000 runs during the second T20I against the West Indies. If successful, he will surpass Suryakumar Yadav’s record for the fastest 2,000 runs in T20I cricket. The match presents an opportunity for Sharma to make history.

sports.title: Man City charges: Mourinho jokes Premier League case will outlast him
sports.summary: Jose Mourinho humorously remarked that he might not witness the conclusion of Manchester City's legal dispute with the Premier League. The club is appealing a ruling that determined it violated financial regulations. Mourinho, known for his criticism of City's spending, made the comment while managing Real Madrid, highlighting the prolonged nature of the ongoing case.

sports.title: Tamil Nadu CM C. Joseph Vijay Felicitates Kodagu Native Joshna Chinappa for Asian Games Bronze Medals
sports.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay felicitated veteran squash player Joshna Chinappa for winning two bronze medals at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Chinappa, 40, earned one medal in mixed doubles with Velavan Senthilkumar and another with the Indian women's team. In recognition of her achievements, the CM announced a cash incentive of ₹30 lakh.

health.title: ​Gender pain gap: Women experience more pain than men across the whole body, major global study finds ‘shocking’ data​
health.summary: A global study involving over 6 million participants across 118 countries reveals that women report experiencing more pain than men across all measured body sites. This research highlights a "gender pain gap," indicating that women consistently experience and report higher levels of pain throughout their lives. The findings challenge the perception of pain as an equal experience for all genders.

health.title: Catch heart changes early before symptoms appear, experts urge
health.summary: Experts at ECHO ASIA / ECHO INDIA 2026 emphasized the significance of detecting early heart changes before symptoms manifest. They advocate for the use of advanced cardiac imaging to identify potential cardiac risks, rather than relying on the onset of symptoms such as chest pain or breathlessness. Early detection is crucial for effective intervention and management of heart conditions.

health.title: New York doctors stress importance of early screening for prostate cancer
health.summary: New York doctors emphasize the critical role of early screening for prostate cancer, as the American Cancer Society estimates that 1 in 8 men will be diagnosed in their lifetime. Black men face the highest prostate cancer death rates among racial groups. Research indicates that early detection through screening significantly improves survival rates, underscoring the need for proactive health measures.

science.title: DNA Typewriter Maps Lineage of 1.28 Million Cells in Mouse Embryo
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Washington have mapped the lineage of 1.28 million cells in a developing mouse embryo. This developmental map details how a single fertilized egg transforms into a complete organism with complex organs, tracked at the cellular level. This achievement marks the first time such comprehensive lineage reconstruction has been accomplished using a "DNA typewriter" technique.

science.title: Nasa sent tiny glow-in-the-dark squid to the space station; scientists removed gravity to study how their glowing bacteria colonise and influence them
science.summary: NASA's UMAMI investigation sent newly hatched bobtail squid, Euprymna scolopes, to the International Space Station to study the effects of microgravity on animal-microbe interactions. Researchers aim to understand how the squid's luminescent bacteria, Vibrio fischeri, colonize and influence them in a weightless environment. This research could provide insights into microbial behavior and symbiotic relationships in space.

science.title: What happens when a rocket crashes into the Moon? Scientists are watching for clues about lunar impacts
science.summary: A discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 stage created a new man-made crater on the Moon after impacting on August 5, 2026, near Einstein Crater. NASA, South Korea's Danuri orbiter, and Earth-based telescopes monitored the event. Scientists are analyzing the debris and chemical signatures from the impact to gain insights into lunar impacts and their effects on the Moon's surface.

entertainment.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' box office collection day 7: Ajay Devgn-Tabu film earns Rs 13 crore; worldwide gross headed for Rs 400 crore mark
entertainment.summary: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion', featuring Ajay Devgn and Tabu, has concluded its first week at the box office with a total collection of approximately Rs 383.60 crore worldwide. On Day 7, the film earned around Rs 13 crore. The total gross is expected to reach the Rs 400 crore mark as it continues to perform well.

entertainment.title: Aquarius Horoscope Today: October 9, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals are encouraged to take a step back and reflect on their emotional investments. The horoscope suggests that recent heartfelt efforts may have led to uncertainty. It advises finding peace by allowing the mind to rest, rather than engaging in sleepless contemplation. Retreating occasionally can enhance productivity and clarity, helping to navigate current feelings and situations effectively.

entertainment.title: Libra Horoscope Today: October 9, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 9, 2026, Libras may feel a need for rest after an energetic period. The transition from Libra season has left some feeling burnt out and in search of rejuvenation. It's a time to take a break and recharge, as the intense pace may have taken its toll. Reflecting and seeking balance is encouraged during this period.
